Class Doctor

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Doctor
public final class Doctor extends Object
The Tempest doctor (/tempest doctor, API 13): looks through every plugin's settings for ways players could make money from nothing, before they find them.

Each plugin does two things in its Doctor.Check. In Doctor.Check.prices(Doctor.Market) it says where players can buy items for coins and where they get coins for items, with its settings as they are now (rank perks and running events included). Core then looks for every item that is bought cheaper in one place than it is sold in another, and every recipe whose parts cost less than what the result sells for. In Doctor.Check.check(Doctor.Market, Doctor.Findings) the plugin looks at its own settings, and can use every plugin's prices (Doctor.Market.worth(String), Doctor.Market.cost(String)). 

registrations.doctor(new Doctor.Check() {
    public void prices(Doctor.Market market) {
        market.sell("a server order", "Ingredient_Bar_Iron", 15, 64, "/myorders");
    }
    public void check(Doctor.Market market, Doctor.Findings findings) {
        if (config.reward() > 1_000_000) findings.warning("huge-reward", "The reward is over a million.", "Reward");
    }
});
Texts are for admins, in English. A fix is a command ("/shop edit") or the words to search for in /tempest ("Sell price"); the doctor page offers it as a button.
